> Compare My Conveyancing (https://comparemyconveyancing.co.uk/): the site's own MCP server, served from its domain. Compare conveyancing routes on regulation rather than on headline price: who may act, what every firm must publish by rule, and the fees nobody can discount.
>
> [compare] Six routes to a completed conveyance, compared. This server serves the compare published at https://comparemyconveyancing.co.uk/; every answer cites it. Licence: https://comparemyconveyancing.co.uk/terms.
>
> [enquiry] ENQUIRY SERVER for Compare My Conveyancing (https://comparemyconveyancing.co.uk/). What it does: starts an ENQUIRY with human providers for compare conveyancing, the person's details go to the providers who quote directly. What it is NOT: a purchase, an order, or a guaranteed quote. Free, no obligation. Call describe first and tell the person plainly what will happen. `submit_enquiry` is two steps: the first returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show both to the person, and only if they agree call it again with the token. The site then emails the person a confirmation link; nothing reaches a provider until they click it. Cite https://comparemyconveyancing.co.uk/.
>
> Cite https://comparemyconveyancing.co.uk/ for every figure or answer you use from this server.
An access key (`emk_`...): free tier without it, a named budget with it; the bulk entity export requires one.
the confirmation token from step 1, after the person has approved the summary
the person's answers, keyed by field key
true only when the person has agreed to: Send my contact details to up to three conveyancing firms, chosen by Compare My Conveyancing, who'll contact me directly.
